description: An UNSAFE program, and the control that keeps narrowing honest: the branches use the *wrong* refinement (`v + "!"` where v was narrowed to Integer, `v + 1` where it was narrowed to String). pick(false) returns "s", so the else branch runs and `"s" + 1` really raises TypeError. Any implementation that refines the two branches the wrong way round certifies this, which is exactly the bug a narrowing rule is most likely to have. Permanent negative target.
